l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: An yi amfani da at tare da lokutan agogo kamar 7 o'clock da noon. Ba don ranakun mako ba ne.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.r.c: Babu in a cikin misalan, don haka ba ya cikin ƙa'idar.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: to kalma ce da ba ta cikin misalan.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Yi amfani da at kafin lokacin agogo, da on kafin ranakun mako da ranaku na musamman. Sunday rana ce ta mako, saboda haka on Sunday.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: on yana zuwa kafin ranakun mako kamar Monday da Friday, saboda haka yi amfani da on kafin Sunday ma.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Ƙa'idar ita ce at ga lokacin agogo, on kuma ga ranakun mako; saboda haka on Sunday.

l-e-e4-b02-14.goal: Nemo ƙa'idar dangantakar abin da ke gaban but da abin da ke bayansa daga misalai da dama, ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada da sabon misali.

l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: A misalai ukun, ɓangarorin kafin da bayan but sun bambanta; saboda haka gajiya amma son wasa ya dace.
l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Bayan but ana sa wani abu da ya saɓa da ɓangaren farko, saboda haka 'I want to play' ya dace.

l-e-e4-b03-12.goal: Daga misalai da dama na tsawon lokaci da aka faɗa kamar daga 1 zuwa 3, nemo ka faɗi ƙa'idar, sannan ka gwada da sabon misali.
l-e-e4-b03-12.material: Fim ɗin daga 1 zuwa 3 ne (sa'o'i 2). Aji daga 2 zuwa 5 ne (sa'o'i 3). Wasa daga 4 zuwa 5 ne (awa 1). Yi amfani da ƙa'idar don gano sa'o'i nawa ne daga 6 zuwa 9.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: 6 lokacin farawa ne kawai. Dole ne ka cire farawa daga ƙarshe.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Jimillar 6 da 9 ce. A misalan, an cire lambobin.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Cire lokacin farawa daga lokacin ƙarshe. 9 − 6 = 3, saboda haka sa'o'i 3 ne.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: A misalan an cire farawa daga ƙarshe, kamar 3 − 1 = 2 da 5 − 2 = 3; saboda haka 9 − 6 = sa'o'i 3.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Lokacin ƙarshe − lokacin farawa shi ne lokacin da ya ɗauka, don haka daga 6 zuwa 9 sa'o'i 3 ne.

l-e-e4-b05-14.s.s1.r.c: after the film na nufin bayan fim. Wannan jerin ya juye.
l-e-e4-b05-14.s.s1.o.d: Ba za a iya sanin jerin ba
l-e-e4-b05-14.s.s1.r.d: before da after suna nuna mana jerin abubuwa.
l-e-e4-b05-14.s.s1.explain: before X na nufin kafin X, after X kuma na nufin bayan X. Abin yana faruwa bayan fim, don haka fim zai fara, pizza kuma daga baya.

l-e-e4-b03-19.goal: Ka kimanta yanayin da aka karanta shafuka 20 cikin shafuka 60 don zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-e-e4-b03-19.material: Littafin labari na Turanci yana da shafuka 60. Ya zuwa yanzu ka karanta shafuka 20.
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne ya dace da adadin da aka karanta?
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s1.r.b: Da a ce rabin littafin ne, da ka karanta shafuka 30.
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Da ka karanta littafin gaba ɗaya, da shafuka 60 ne.
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Da a ce 2/3 ne, da ka karanta shafuka 40.
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s1.explain: Idan ka raba shafuka 60 daidai gida 3, kowane sashe shafuka 20 ne. Shafuka 20 su ne 1/3.
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: 60 da aka raba da 3 ya zama 20, saboda haka shafuka 20 kusan 1/3 ne.
l-e-e4-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Dole a haɗa shafuka 20 sau 3 don a samu shafuka 60, saboda haka adadin da aka karanta shi ne 1/3.

l-e-e4-b03-20.title: Kimanta ranar da ta gabata kwanaki 3
l-e-e4-b03-20.topic: Wace rana ce kwanaki 3 da suka wuce?
l-e-e4-b03-20.goal: Idan yau Juma'a ce, ka kimanta ranar da ta gabata kwanaki 3 don zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilin.
l-e-e4-b03-20.material: Yau Juma'a ce. Wani aboki ya ce, 'Na kalli fim kwanaki 3 da suka wuce.'
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: A wace rana abokin ya kalli fim ɗin?
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.r.a: Laraba ita ce kwanaki 2 da suka wuce.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.r.c: Alhamis ita ce kwana 1 da ya wuce.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: Litinin ita ce kwanaki 4 da suka wuce.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.explain: Daga Juma'a, ranar da ta gabata kwana 1 ita ce Alhamis, kwanaki 2 ita ce Laraba, kwanaki 3 kuma ita ce Talata.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka kirga baya sau 3 daga Juma'a, a samu Talata, saboda haka kwanaki 3 da suka wuce Talata ce.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka kirga baya kwana ɗaya bayan ɗaya, za a samu Alhamis, Laraba, Talata, saboda haka kwanaki 3 da suka wuce Talata ce.

l-e-e4-b04-16.title: Yawan siffofin da aka haddace a makonni 4
l-e-e4-b04-16.goal: Kimanta yawan sabbin siffofin da aka haddace a makonni 4, zaɓi girma ko zango mai dacewa, ka bayyana dalili.
l-e-e4-b04-16.material: Kana haddace sabbin siffofi 6 a rana. Idan ka yi ba tare da rasa rana ba na makonni 4 (kwanaki 28), kimanta yawan da za ka samu.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin siffofi ne ya dace ga makonni 4?
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: Wannan kusan haddace 6 a rana na kwanaki 5 kawai ne. Kwanaki 28 sun fi yawa.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Wannan 6×100 ne. Kwanaki 28 ba 100 ba ne.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Ya yi yawa sosai. 6 sau 28 ma bai kai 200 ba.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.explain: 6×28 kusan 170 ne, kaɗan ƙasa da 6×30. Daidai 168 ne.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Da 6 a rana, a kimanta kwanaki 28 a matsayin 30, kusan 180; saboda haka 170 ya dace.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: 6×28=168, kusan 170 ne, sauran zaɓuɓɓuka sun yi ƙanƙanta ko girma.

l-e-e4-b04-17.title: Kalmomin wuri su ne 1 daga kusan nawa?
l-e-e4-b04-17.goal: Kimanta rabon kalmomin da ke nuna wuri, zaɓi girma ko zango da ya dace, ka bayyana dalili.
l-e-e4-b04-17.material: Shafi ɗaya na littafin hoto yana da kalmomi 40. Cikinsu 8 kalmomi ne na wuri kamar in, on, under. Kimanta su 1 daga kalmomi nawa.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.prompt: Kusan nawa daga cikin duka kalmomin kalmomin wuri ne?
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: Wannan yana nufin kusan kalmomi 20. 8 sun fi ƙasa da haka.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.r.c: Wannan kusan kalmomi 2 ne. 8 sun fi haka yawa.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: Wannan yana nufin 1 ko ƙasa daga kalmomi 40, ya yi kaɗan.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.explain: Idan aka raba abubuwa 40 rukuni 5, kowane rukuni yana da 8. Saboda haka abubuwa 8 su ne 1/5 na jimilla.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: 40 a raba da 8 yana ba da 5, don haka kalmomin wuri kusan 1/5 ne.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Rukuni 5 mai abubuwa 8 yana ba da 40, saboda haka 1/5 ne, 1/2 ko 1/20 ba su dace da 8 ba.

l-e-e4-b04-19.material: Rubutun Turanci yana da sakin layi 3. Kowane sakin layi yana da jimloli 4, kowace jimla kuma kusan kalmomi 8. Kimanta yawan kalmomin rubutun.
l-e-e4-b04-19.s.s1.prompt: Wane yawan kalma ne ya dace ga dukan rubutun?

l-e-e4-b04-19.s.s1.r.b: Jimloli 12 ne kawai, wannan ya yi yawa.
l-e-e4-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: An ɗauki jimla ɗaya tana da kalmomi 100. Ya yi yawa.
l-e-e4-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: Akwai 3×4=12 jimloli, kowace jimla kalmomi 8 ce, 12×8=96, kusan kalmomi 100.
l-e-e4-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: Kowane sakin layi yana da jimloli 4, jimloli 12 kenan, kalmomi 8 kowace, kusan 100.

l-e-e4-b04-20.material: Kana rubuta abin da za ka yi gobe cikin jimloli 5 na will. Jimla ɗaya yawanci kalmomi 6 zuwa 10 ce. Kimanta zangon yawan kalmomi a jimloli 5.

l-e-e4-b05-16.goal: Ka kimanta yawan matakan da ake bukata don auna gefen aji mai tsawon 8 m, ka zabi girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-e4-b05-16.material: Gefen aji mai tsawo kusan 8 m ne. Mataki nawa daya kusan 50 cm ne. Ka kimanta kusan matakai nawa za a dauka don auna gefen mai tsawon.
l-e-e4-b05-16.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin matakai ne ya dace?
l-e-e4-b05-16.s.s1.r.a: Matakai 400 masu tsawon 50 cm kowanne suna bada 200 m. Wannan ya yi tsawo sosai.
l-e-e4-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Matakai 160 masu tsawon 50 cm kowanne suna bada 80 m. Wannan ya yi tsawo sosai.

l-e-e4-b05-16.s.s1.explain: 8 m daidai yake da 800 cm, kuma 800 ÷ 50 = 16, saboda haka kusan matakai 16 ne. A wasu kalmomi, matakai 2 suna bada 1 m.

l-e-e4-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: 800 cm idan aka raba da 50 cm yana bada 16, saboda haka kusan matakai 16 ne suka dace.

l-e-e4-b05-17.material: Akwai kusan matakala 20 daga hawa daya zuwa hawa na gaba. Idan ka hau matakala daga hawa na 1 zuwa hawa na 4, ka kimanta kusan matakala nawa ne gaba daya.
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin matakala ne ya dace?
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s1.r.a: Wannan shi ne adadin na hawa daya. Daga hawa na 1 zuwa hawa na 4 akwai karin hawa.
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s1.r.c: Ba sau 4 ba ne. Daga hawa na 1 zuwa hawa na 4, ana hawa hawa uku.
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya yi yawa. Akwai matakala 20 a kowane hawa.
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s1.explain: Kana hawa sau uku: daga hawa na 1 zuwa na 2, daga hawa na 2 zuwa na 3, sannan daga hawa na 3 zuwa na 4. 20 × 3 = 60, saboda haka akwai kusan matakala 60.
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s2.model.0: Daga hawa na 1 zuwa hawa na 4 ana hawa hawa uku, don haka kusan 20 × 3 = matakala 60 ne.
l-e-e4-b05-17.s.s2.model.1: Ba yawan benaye ba ne, yawan hawa ne; ana hawa sau uku, saboda haka kusan matakala 60 ya dace.

l-e-e4-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: Jerin haruffa ba shi da alaƙa da ma’ana, amma nau’i-nau’i suna haɗa ma’anoni; saboda haka P ta fi kyau.
